args.subject: Hartford gate kiosks: incident summary
args.body:
Hi Mateo,

A short summary of the Hartford gate kiosk incident, as promised:
- The gate kiosks went offline on 3 August 2026; both inbound lanes showed a white screen after badge scan.
- Both lanes were working again as of 11:07 that morning.
- Your status-page access is a separate issue and is tracked in ticket INC-4821; we are still chasing it.

Gideon
